source.title: SWE-Explore: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Explore Repositories
source.summary: Introduces a benchmark of 848 issues across 10 languages that isolates repository exploration, evaluating agents on coverage, ranking, and context-efficiency under a fixed line budget. Finds agentic explorers form a clear tier above classical retrieval and that line-level coverage and efficient ranking are the key differentiators.
